snippet.title: Monster Punk - Official Trailer | The MIX | Kinda Funny Spring Game Showcase
snippet.description: Dominate the ultimate motor-sport ritual. Smash, blast, and pull off wild stunts through extreme tournament challenges. Out-score rivals alone or co-op to survive elimination, win the 1v1 final showdown, and earn the cash to upgrade your ride. Rise from "nobody" to arena champion. Monster Punk will be available on PC.
